# GlitchRealm

> GlitchRealm (glitchrealm.ca) is a browser-game platform where players discover and play indie web games, and developers publish their games to a curated community.

Play games: [https://glitchrealm.ca/games.html](https://glitchrealm.ca/games.html)
Submit a game: [https://glitchrealm.ca/submit-game.html](https://glitchrealm.ca/submit-game.html)

## Changelog

- [Changelog overview](https://glitchrealm.ca/changelog/): every published release, fully rendered in HTML. No JavaScript required.
- [RSS feed](https://glitchrealm.ca/changelog/feed.xml): RSS 2.0, one item per published release.
- [Atom feed](https://glitchrealm.ca/changelog/atom.xml): Atom 1.0.
- [JSON release index](https://glitchrealm.ca/changelog/releases.json): machine-readable index (schema at /changelog/releases.schema.json).

## Platform

- [Games](https://glitchrealm.ca/games.html): the community game directory.
- [News](https://glitchrealm.ca/news.html): platform announcements.
- [Support](https://glitchrealm.ca/support.html): player and developer support.
- [Developers](https://developers.glitchrealm.ca/): developer portal and resources.
